case_templates.name: SOC-Incident-Response
case_templates.description: Standard incident response case for confirmed security incidents

tasks.title: 1. Detection & Triage
tasks.description:
## Initial Triage

- [ ] Verify alert is a true positive
- [ ] Determine affected systems (IPs, hostnames)
- [ ] Identify affected user accounts
- [ ] Determine initial access vector
- [ ] Assess initial severity and business impact
- [ ] Notify SOC lead if severity >= High

**Tools:** Wazuh Dashboard, Zeek logs, Velociraptor

tasks.title: 2. Containment
tasks.description:
## Containment Actions

- [ ] Isolate affected host (Velociraptor quarantine or firewall block)
- [ ] Block malicious IPs in pfSense/firewall
- [ ] Reset compromised credentials
- [ ] Block C2 domains in DNS/proxy
- [ ] Preserve evidence before containment
- [ ] Document all containment actions with timestamps

**Commands:**
```
# Velociraptor host isolation (VQL):
SELECT quarantine(message='Isolated by SOC') FROM scope()

# pfSense block IP:
pfctl -t blocklist -T add MALICIOUS_IP
```

tasks.title: 3. Forensic Investigation
tasks.description:
## Deep Dive Investigation

- [ ] Collect Velociraptor IR artifact bundle
- [ ] Dump memory of suspicious processes
- [ ] Extract and hash all artifacts
- [ ] Reconstruct attack timeline
- [ ] Identify lateral movement paths
- [ ] Determine persistence mechanisms
- [ ] Check MISP for known threat actor attribution
- [ ] Submit unknown files to VirusTotal (via Cortex)

**Velociraptor Collections:**
- Linux.Collection.LiveResponse
- Linux.Sys.BashHistory
- Generic.Network.Netstat
- SOCLab.HuntPersistence

tasks.title: 4. Eradication
tasks.description:
## Remove Threat

- [ ] Remove malware/backdoors
- [ ] Delete persistence mechanisms (cron, systemd, startup)
- [ ] Revoke attacker access (SSH keys, accounts)
- [ ] Patch exploited vulnerability
- [ ] Verify eradication with IOC scan
- [ ] Document all changes made

**Verify clean:**
```bash
osqueryi 'SELECT * FROM crontab WHERE command LIKE "%/tmp/%";'
osqueryi 'SELECT * FROM authorized_keys;'
osqueryi 'SELECT path FROM suid_bin WHERE path NOT IN ("/usr/bin/sudo","/bin/su");'
```

tasks.title: 5. Recovery & Monitoring
tasks.description:
## Restore and Monitor

- [ ] Restore from clean backup if needed
- [ ] Re-enable isolated systems (staged)
- [ ] Enable enhanced monitoring (OSQuery IR pack)
- [ ] Monitor for re-compromise for 72h
- [ ] Verify all IOCs still blocked
- [ ] Run Velociraptor persistence hunt on all endpoints

tasks.title: 6. Lessons Learned
tasks.description:
## Post-Incident Review

- [ ] Document complete attack timeline
- [ ] Root cause analysis
- [ ] Detection gaps identified
- [ ] Rules/signatures added/updated
- [ ] MISP: add new IOCs from this incident
- [ ] Update playbooks
- [ ] Brief stakeholders
- [ ] Calculate MTTD / MTTR

tasks.title: 1. Define Hunt Hypothesis
tasks.description:
- [ ] State hypothesis (e.g., 'Attacker using DNS tunneling for exfil')
- [ ] Identify data sources needed
- [ ] Define success criteria
- [ ] Set time scope

tasks.title: 2. Collect & Analyze Data
tasks.description:
- [ ] Run RITA beaconing detection
- [ ] Query OSQuery across all endpoints
- [ ] Run Velociraptor hunt
- [ ] Analyze Arkime PCAP
- [ ] Cross-reference with MISP IOCs

tasks.title: 3. Document Findings
tasks.description:
- [ ] Log all findings (positive and negative)
- [ ] Create new IOCs in MISP if threats found
- [ ] Update detection rules if gaps found
- [ ] Close hunt with final report
